summary: A compromised Microsoft PyPI package turned developer workstations into cloud-credential theft targets while Apache Roller, Puppet Enterprise, OpenJDK and Apache HTTP Server all drew fresh exploitation warnings; Oracle shipped a 655-fix bundle and intrusions at Fugaku, Infoblox and ScreenConnect MSPs widened the third-party blast radius.
